**What I checked after reloading:** I can't hover the mouse from here, so I tested the wobble by running its animation on "Get it" directly, and it squashed as expected. I haven't seen a real hover myself. The mod reported no errors.

If your system is set to reduce motion, the wobble is switched off.

The wobble is a new mod. To undo it, switch off **Jelly Buttons** in the side panel, or ask me to.
